### A Good Purpose for That Bad Story
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-may-23-2019.html
Passage: Genesis 41:52
Points:
- Rather than erasing painful memories, God redeems difficult chapters of life for good purposes.
- Joseph named his second son Ephraim to recognize that God made him fruitful amidst affliction.
- Jacob deliberately prioritized Ephraim over Manasseh, illustrating that bearing fruit matters even more than forgetting past trauma.
- Enduring hardships equips believers to offer comfort and empathy to others facing similar struggles.

### The Key to a Fruitful Life
Author: Pastor Jeff Schreve
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/fromhisheart/the-key-to-a-fruitful-life-from-his-heart-week-of-march-11.html
Passage: Genesis 41:50-52
Points:
- Joseph chose not to harbor bitterness toward his brothers despite years of mistreatment and wrongful imprisonment.
- Naming his first son Manasseh shows that forgiving others allows God to remove the sting of past injuries.
- Naming his second son Ephraim shows that granting forgiveness opens the doorway to abundant blessing.
- Believers cannot experience full spiritual fruitfulness while clinging to resentment and unforgiveness.
- Surrendering grievances to God transforms places of affliction into places of lasting fruitfulness.
